requirements.description: The user explicitly requires at least 180 sqm of gross floor area. The 14-person capacity is not converted into an area filter because no verified gross-area threshold per occupant was supplied by the RegulatoryAgent.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE surface_area >= 180 ORDER BY id ASC
output.explanation: Applies the surface requirement (surface_area >= 180), which is in both the runtime schema and the filterable columns. The requirement tipologia_bene_immobile = 'Attività scolastiche' was not applied because tipologia_bene_immobile is not in the filterable_columns allowlist (the matching filterable field is property_type). No location was supplied, so results are ordered by id ASC.
